title: Anthropic Hunts for Australia Data Center Deals, Says Envoy
key_facts: Anthropic is exploring data center investments across Australia, preferring regional locations and brownfield sites powered by renewable energy, Bloomberg reported.
Jeff Bleich, Anthropic's international special envoy, spoke at the Australian Financial Review's Energy and Climate Summit in Sydney on Tuesday (13 Oct 2026).
Bleich said state premiers had pitched several projects to the company and that he did not think any state is out of contention.
Anthropic would prefer facilities away from major population centers and powered by renewable energy.

Anthropic has committed $50 billion to data center facilities at several US locations, including Texas and New York, and recently secured a $35 billion loan to lease computing chips across five data centers, backed by a Google guarantee.
Alexander Smith, Google's head of Asia-Pacific infrastructure and energy, said Google was 'increasingly convinced' that pairing renewable generation with data centers is feasible in Australia.
